groups.name: Annotation data flow: selection to queueable prompts
groups.rationale: Extracts the core logic that turns a text selection into structured annotations ready to send, independent of DOM operations or UI rendering.

groups.name: Conversation panel rendering and state
groups.rationale: Renders the right-side panel showing queued pills, delivered conversation, and send UI as a pure function, separating markup generation from DOM interaction.

groups.name: Selection popup and annotation trigger
groups.rationale: Turns a mouseup text selection into annotation fragments split along file blocks, displays them in a floating popup, and routes queued prompts to the panel.

groups.name: Session API for fetch, persist, and send
groups.rationale: Centralizes all HTTP routes the browser needs: loading the session, persisting reviewed flags, and sending feedback with prompts and end-of-session flag.

groups.name: Diff view mounting and update
groups.rationale: Mounts the diff into the DOM with reviewed checkboxes, persists checkbox changes, and exposes an update method so a re-group can redraw without losing scroll position.

groups.name: Panel mounting with feedback send
groups.rationale: Mounts the conversation panel, manages unsent queue state separately from server pending, removes pills on demand, and sends feedback bundling queued annotations with optional general comment.

groups.name: Main entry point and component orchestration
groups.rationale: Loads the session, mounts diff and panel, wires the annotation popup to the panel's queue method, and subscribes to session updates to refresh both views.

groups.name: Styling for popup, panel, and interactive elements
groups.rationale: Adds CSS for the annotation popup, queued pills, conversation entries, textarea and buttons, using existing design tokens for consistency with the diff view.

groups.name: Build and configuration updates
groups.rationale: Updates the entry point path after refactoring main.ts into dom/, excludes the DOM module from the base tsconfig, and marks Task 8 complete in the plan.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
